comment: The required gates for a GoTavern release. scripts/verify-release-gates.mjs runs inside the publish job BEFORE gh release create and fails closed unless every workflow named here has a completed successful run whose head_sha is the commit the release tag points at. This file is hand-maintained on purpose (it is the release policy); the gate that consumes it is machine-enforced. GoTavern Release itself is NOT listed: a workflow cannot be its own precondition. The publishing run supplies its own build + prepublish qualification at the same tag commit, and the prepublish job executes the bare installers against the archives this very run built.

requiredGates.why: verify (gofmt, generated facts, compatibility matrix, classifier table, Go suite, vet, build, assets verify), race, browser evidence and the oracle sweep
one stock tree per subject, one browser lineage, restart on the same tree, and the 39-guard judgement
before/after/atDepth world-info slots reach the final provider request in pinned's order
the packaged archive boots against a stock SillyTavern tree on Linux and Windows
the pinned frontend's real journeys against a real browser, including the Q21 hand-back judge
fresh install, idempotence, update/rollback and cross-baseline data survival from the extracted archive
the paired performance record and the soak
the container image builds, verifies its tokenizer assets and smokes a pinned route
